name: M600
start_print_macro:
; Start of PRINT_START macro

G215 F15000 W1 ; Activate gas flow and set minimum oxygen value
M114
G100 S5 ; Chiller relay on
G100 S6 ; Chiller enable
G4 S5 ; Time to establish stable gas flow
M400 ; Wait until finish Gcode buffer
G90 ; Absolute mode
G117 ; Home axis Z
M83 ; Extrusion relative mode
G100 F1 ; Door fan enabled
G123 C W Z15 S200 ; Define process sensibility - automatic current
T0 ; Select tool

M400 ; Wait until finish Gcode buffer
G114 ; Tare Load Cell

; End of PRINT_START macro
end_print_macro:
; Start of PRINT_END macro

G108 W0
G91 ; Relative mode
G1 Z150 F600
G90 ; Absolute mode
G1 X150 Y200 F2400
M150 R0 U128 B0 P255 ; End light colour

; End of PRINT_END macro
start_deposition_macro:
; Start of START_DEPOSITION macro
; Feature: #feature_type


M400 ; Wait until finish Gcode buffer
G108 P W1000 E ; Laser power
G4 P100 ; Laser power ramp up
M400 ; Wait until finish Gcode buffer
G1 E2 F2400
G123 E C W ; Enable process control current mode
G112 P O ; Turn OFF HotWire
G108 P W#laser_power E ; Laser power

; End of START_DEPOSITION macro
stop_deposition_macro:
; Start of STOP_DEPOSITION macro

G123 D
G1 E-#retraction F2400
G4 S0.1 ; Laser on time after retraction
M400 ; Wait until finish Gcode buffer
G108 W0

; End of STOP_DEPOSITION macro
pre_short_travel_macro:
; Start of PRE_SHORT_TRAVEL macro

G123 D

; End of PRE_SHORT_TRAVEL macro
short_travel_end_macro:
; Start of SHORT_TRAVEL_END macro

G123 E I

; End of SHORT_TRAVEL_END macro
